title: Annotatio V §.VI: Two grades from vulgar opinion — Political vs Ecclesiastical Tolerance confused
pass_a_gloss: I say that the limits of Ecclesiastical Consociation become conspicuous in two grades, namely from the opinion of the vulgar, by which Political Tolerance is confused with Ecclesiastical Tolerance;
pass_b_english: I mark those two grades chiefly because common opinion mixes Political Tolerance with Ecclesiastical Tolerance.
That confusion is what makes the double ladder look sharp to the crowd.
source_text: Dico duobus gradibus conspicuos fieri Consociationis Ecclesiasticae limites, scilicet ex vulgi opinione, quâ Tolerantia Politica cum Tolerantia Ecclesiastica confunditur;
notes: Vulgar confusion: Tolerantia Politica vs Ecclesiastica.
